provided_surfaces.listLeaseSnapshot: Returns unexpired account/character lease ownership rows; grace rows may be included for operator diagnostics.
provided_surfaces.listOnlineCharacters: Returns only unexpired active character leases; this is an authoritative online ownership signal, not character gameplay state.
provided_surfaces.revokeSession: CAS-safe removal of leases owned by one session plus disconnect arbitration.
provided_surfaces.revokeAccount: Resolves the current account lease, removes that session's ownership leases, and requests disconnect.
provided_surfaces.kickCharacter: Resolves the authoritative character lease and revokes the owning session; it does not mutate character stats, inventory, zone state, or game packets.

ws08_boundary.integration_note: WS08 may bridge these WS45-owned read/revoke surfaces, but full ADMIN_RUNTIME_AUTHORITY still requires the WS03/game runtime owner for gameplay state and online mutations.
